Dear [CONSUMER NAME],

Re: Dispute of Account ACC-819796

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute letter regarding the account with our agency, ACC-819796. We understand that you have disputed this account as "not mine" and have requested its removal from your credit report.

We have reviewed the account information and can confirm that the original creditor for this account is Summit Trust Bank. Our records also indicate that the account was charged off on May 23, 2021, and the last payment was received on May 3, 2023.

As per the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), 15 U.S.C. § 1681g, we are required to provide you with the name and address of the original creditor, which we have done. We will investigate your dispute and verify the accuracy of the information in your credit report.

We will also provide you with a written validation of the debt, as required by the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), 15 U.S.C. § 1692g. This validation will be sent to you separately.

Please note that we will not remove the account from your credit report at this time, as we must first investigate and verify the accuracy of the information. However, we will take your dispute into consideration and update your credit report accordingly.

You have the right to further dispute this account if you believe it is still inaccurate. Please contact us within 30 days if you have any additional information or concerns.

Sincerely,

[AGENCY NAME]
